## Summary

**Rate used:** GBP 1.2500 USD/GBP — March 2026 Treasury policy rate (DOC-0201).

**1. Management fee — JE-00305 (pending approval)**
USD 15,000 ÷ 1.2500 = **GBP 12,000.00**
- Dr 6550 Intercompany Management Fees 12,000.00
- Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable 12,000.00

Support: DOC-0206 (invoice ICI-2026-03-UK), DOC-0201.

This measures USD 15,000, **above the USD 10,000 senior-accountant limit** in Policy s.1, so I requested controller approval immediately after posting. It stays pending until you approve. I deliberately did not split it into two sub-threshold entries — s.1 prohibits that.

**2. Loan remeasurement — JE-00306 (posted, no approval needed)**
The USD 200,000 loan is a monetary liability in a non-functional currency, so it remeasures at month-end:
- Required: USD 200,000 ÷ 1.2500 = GBP 160,000.00
- Carrying: GBP 157,480.31 (drawdown at 1.2700)
- **FX loss: GBP 2,519.69**

Dr 6950 FX Gain/Loss / Cr 2400 Intercompany Loan Payable. Support: DOC-0016, DOC-0201. At GBP 2,519.69 (USD 3,149.61) this is under the threshold.

Worth noting: Jan and Feb correctly required no remeasurement — the policy rate was 1.2700 at both month-ends, identical to the drawdown rate. March is the first movement, and GBP weakening makes the fixed USD obligation costlier in GBP, producing a loss rather than a gain.

**Two judgment calls to flag:**

- I verified both sides against the US ledger: US 1410 shows USD 200,000 and US 4800 shows USD 15,000 income. Both intercompany pairs tie out in USD with zero residual — no plugs were needed.
- I set the UK "Intercompany reconciliation" checklist item to **in_progress, not complete**. The two items you asked for are done and agree, but that item's full scope (UK↔DE balances, other IC AR/AP) wasn't in this request and I haven't reviewed it. It shouldn't be signed off as complete on the strength of this work alone.

**Your action:** JE-00305 needs approval to finalize; JE-00306 is complete.
